summary: A hexagonal reinforced-concrete tower lit in 1913 on Newfoundland's Great Northern Peninsula, kept for generations by the Beaudoin family.

access.note: Staffed federal station per LighthouseFriends; grounds open, tower closed; road reaches New Ferolle.

keepers.name: Damase Beaudoin
keepers.note: First keeper; also spelled Demase in narrative

keepers.name: Jaye Roberts
keepers.note: First woman principal keeper in Newfoundland, per source
